name: database-technology-selection
description: Select database technology for a given use case. Evaluates across DB classes (relational / document / wide-column / key-value / graph / time-series / search / vector / cache / analytical / ledger / newSQL) and maps to specific products. Criteria: consistency model, scale envelope, query patterns, schema flexibility, ops complexity, cost, ecosystem. Recommendation with reversal conditions. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
